about: What each battle enemy looks like, for the I key in battle (#699). Key each entry by the enemy's name as the game shows it, such as "Goblin"; one entry covers every enemy with that name. Write one or two plain sentences in your own words from what you see in play: shape, size, colour, what it holds. Never copy the game's text. Leave out any enemy you haven't seen. For a variant that looks different from others of its name, add an entry under "ids" keyed by its enemy id, such as "412"; it wins over the name's entry.
